definitions.gloss: to stretch around; to set up all around; to surround with
definitions.explanation: to extend or stretch something (like wire, rope, or barriers) around an area

definitions.gloss: to spread (a network); to establish (connections) throughout
definitions.explanation: used figuratively for networks, surveillance, information systems, or relationships that extend throughout an area

examples.english: I put up a fence around the garden.
